scenes.name: LOCAL AND GLOBAL
lines: Can a network obey a balance rule at every edge, yet have different lengths in different places?
一张路网能否每条边都满足平衡规则，长度却随位置改变？
A tree is a connected graph with no cycles. We use an infinite tree with three neighbors at every vertex.
树是连通且无环的图。我们先用每个顶点都有三个邻居的无限树。
Haobo Ma and Wenlin Zhang construct a counterexample: lengths vary along one infinite path, while every junction away from it has equal incident lengths.
Haobo Ma 与 Wenlin Zhang 构造了反例：长度沿一条无限路径改变，而路径外每个路口的入射边都等长。

scenes.name: THE LOCAL RULE
lines: At a junction, add the reciprocals of the lengths to get c. Add their squares to get d. The ratio c over d is its effective length R.
在一个路口，把边长倒数相加得到 c，把这些倒数的平方相加得到 d。比值 c 除以 d 是有效长度 R。
Equal incident lengths give that same effective length. If three edges all have length two, R is two.
入射边全等长时，有效长度就等于边长。三条边都长二时，R 就是二。
The edge rule uses the two endpoint ratios: the length is the sum of their squares divided by their sum. Ratios one and two require length five thirds.
边的规则使用两端比值：边长等于平方和除以和。两端比值为一和二时，边长须为三分之五。
But the ratios must also come from the surrounding edges. This consistency is the problem to solve.
但比值本身还须由周围的边算出。要解决的正是这种相容性。

scenes.name: CONSTRUCT THE TREE
lines: Take a path extending forever in both directions. Call it the spine, and number its vertices by all integers n.
选一条向两端无限延伸的路径，称为主干，用所有整数 n 标记顶点。
At vertex n, attach an infinite binary branch. Every edge in that branch, including its attachment, has length two to the power n.
在顶点 n 接一棵无限二叉分支。分支中每条边，包括连接边，都长二的 n 次方。
Give the next spine edge five thirds times that scale. Each spine vertex has two spine neighbors and one branch; each branch vertex has a parent and two children.
下一条主干边取该尺度的三分之五倍。主干点有两个主干邻居和一个分支；分支点有一个父点、两个子点。
The graph is a tree of degree three. The drawing shows only a finite portion; its lengths are labels, not distances on the screen.
这给出每点度数为三的树。图中仅画有限部分；长度由标签表示，并非屏幕上的距离。

scenes.name: CHECK EVERY EDGE TYPE
lines: At the central spine vertex, the three lengths are five sixths, five thirds, and one. Both sums are fourteen fifths, so its ratio is one.
在中央主干点，三条边长为六分之五、三分之五和一。倒数和与倒数平方和都为五分之十四，所以比值是一。
Scaling the lengths by two to the power n makes the ratio two to the power n. Every vertex in the attached branch has that same ratio.
把长度乘以二的 n 次方，比值也变成二的 n 次方。所接分支内的每个顶点都有同样的比值。
Branch and attachment edges join equal ratios. Spine edges join ratios s and twice s, and have exactly the required length, five thirds s.
分支边和连接边连接相等的比值。主干边两端比值为 s 与二倍 s，其长度恰为所需的三分之五倍 s。
These two cases check every edge of the infinite tree. An attachment of length one sits beside a spine edge of length five thirds, proving nonconstancy.
这两种情况检查了无限树的每条边。长一的连接边紧邻长三分之五的主干边，证明整体不等长。

scenes.name: WHY BRANCHES DO NOT DISTURB BALANCE
lines: Here is the general mechanism. Start with any junction whose ratio is R. Add m edges, each of length R.
一般机制如下：从比值为 R 的路口出发，增加 m 条边，每条长 R。
The new sums are c plus m over R, and d plus m over R squared. Since c equals R times d, the ratio stays R.
新的和分别为 c 加 m 除以 R，以及 d 加 m 除以 R 平方。由于 c 等于 R 乘 d，比值仍为 R。
Extend each new edge into a constant-length branch. Its new vertices also have ratio R, so every new edge balances and every old edge keeps its equation.
把新边延伸为等长分支。新顶点比值也为 R，于是所有新边平衡，所有旧边仍满足原方程。
This fills missing neighbors in any connected, locally finite tree solution with an edge and bounded degree, producing the corresponding regular tree solution.
这能为任意连通、局部有限、有边且度数有相应上界的树解补足邻居，得到对应正则树上的解。

scenes.name: RESULT AND SCOPE
lines: The public Lean theorem proves the cubic constancy conjecture false. Its proof constructs this fixed infinite example.
公开 Lean 定理证明三正则树常值猜想为假，其证明构造的正是这个固定的无限反例。
The written paper also proves a family for every integer q at least two, with positive scales t times r to the power n, where r is positive and different from one.
论文还书面证明了每个整数 q 至少为二时的家族：尺度为正数 t 乘 r 的 n 次方，其中 r 为正且不等于一。
These scales approach zero at one end and grow without bound at the other. They do not satisfy the separate asymptotically constant boundary hypothesis.
这些尺度在一端趋零、另一端无界增长，不满足另一个定理要求的渐近常值边界条件。
The lesson is precise: equal incident lengths at a junction do not force global constancy. Attaching branches can preserve local balance while the whole geometry varies.
结论很明确：一个路口的入射边等长，不能迫使整体等长。添加分支可以保留局部平衡，同时让整体几何变化。
